name: Prayer In School
overview: Scripture affirms the importance of children being taught by the Lord, promising peace as a result of such instruction (Isaiah 54:13). Jesus welcomes children to come to Him, highlighting their special place in the kingdom of heaven (Matthew 19:14). Prayer is presented as a vital practice, encouraging believers to bring all concerns to God with thanksgiving (Philippians 4:6). Additionally, Christ warns against performing righteous acts for public approval, emphasizing sincerity in spiritual devotion (Matthew 6:1). Together, these verses underscore the biblical foundation for prayer and godly teaching within the school environment.
